questions.title: CBIC cuts paperwork in deferred customs duty scheme to boost MSME participation and ease cash flow
questions.subject: economy
questions.q: With reference to “CBIC cuts paperwork in deferred customs duty scheme to boost MSME participation and ease cash flow”, consider the following statements:
items: The CBIC is simplifying its deferred customs duty scheme for manufacturers.
Outreach programs will now handhold MSMEs to encourage scheme adoption.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is correct.
